name: Timberline Breach Golem
languages: Understands the languages of its creator but can't speak

Traits.name: Magic Resistance
Traits.text: The breach golem has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The breach golem makes two Splintering Shoulder attacks.

Actions.name: Splintering Shoulder
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +8, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Breaching Shove (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 16, each creature in a 60-foot-long, 5-foot-wide Line. *Failure:* 45 (13d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.clause: The golem charges in a straight line through a wall, pillar, or other solid barrier, smashing a shower of debris outward
Actions.expresses: shouldering through walls in a shower of debris

lore: Raised by a siege-wright from a felled forest and still obeying its last order: break every wall between it and the keep.

generation.userConcept: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls

clauses.text: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber

generation.cite: composition after Flesh Golem (CR 5) — the made thing that cannot be unmade
generation.gap_death_sites: 1x the call named no template for the pick

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned
monsterDescription: a siege-engine golem of lashed timber that shoulders through walls
